title: Secure AI for Legacy Code in Regulated Environments
blurb: An air-gapped, API-free legacy transformation pipeline: AI-assisted COBOL and C conversion toward Java and Rust, with controlled validation and modular design for regulated, mission-critical contexts.
result: Legacy code modernized without leaving the air gap

meta.industry: Legacy modernization, regulated and mission-critical systems

whoFor: Organizations running COBOL or C systems in regulated or mission-critical environments who need to modernize without sending code to an external API or opening a network path that compliance will not allow.
challengeIntro: Legacy COBOL and C systems keep regulated and mission-critical organizations running, but they also become harder to maintain, hire for, and extend every year. The usual AI-assisted modernization tools assume a cloud API is available to call. In an air-gapped, regulated environment, that assumption alone rules most of them out.
challengePoints: Modernization needed to happen without any external API calls or network egress.
COBOL and C logic often encodes business rules that are not documented anywhere else.
Converted code had to be validated, not just generated, before anyone could trust it.
The environment demanded modular, auditable design, not a black-box rewrite.
identifiedIntro: The constraint was not really about AI capability, it was about where the AI could run and what guarantees the output needed. Covison built the transformation pipeline to run entirely air-gapped, with validation built in rather than bolted on.
builtIntro: Covison designed and deployed an air-gapped, API-free legacy transformation pipeline that:
builtPoints: Runs AI-assisted COBOL and C analysis and conversion entirely offline
Targets Java and Rust as modernization outputs
Applies controlled validation to converted code before it is trusted
Uses a modular design suited to regulated, mission-critical review processes
whyNotOffTheShelf: Most AI code-migration tools are built around calling a hosted model over the internet. That is a non-starter in air-gapped, regulated environments, so the tooling itself, not just the model, had to be rebuilt to run entirely on-premises.
productionReality: Operates entirely air-gapped, with no external API dependency.
Built for regulated, mission-critical review and audit requirements.
Modular design allows validation at each stage of conversion, not just at the end.
outcomeBullets: Legacy COBOL and C systems can be modernized without leaving the air gap.
Business logic is preserved and validated through the conversion, not just translated blind.
Gives regulated teams a modernization path that fits their compliance constraints instead of fighting them.
